title.gu: યુનિટ 3 Notes — Detailed Estimate ની તૈયારી

h.gu: 3.1 વ્યાખ્યા, જરૂરી data અને તૈયારીની પ્રક્રિયા

items.syllabus_item: 3.1 detailed estimate data civil cost GST contingencies supervision agency charges taking out quantities and abstracting

body.en:
A detailed estimate lists accurately measured items, quantities, specifications, unit rates and amounts for a defined project. Start with coordinated plans, elevations, sections, structural and service details, site survey, soil and foundation information, specification, current authorised SOR or justified market rates, lead/lift, tax and departmental charging rules. Record drawing revision, measurement rules and assumptions.

Taking out quantities: break work into non-overlapping items; take dimensions in a consistent order, apply relevant deductions and record calculation on a measurement sheet. Abstracting: transfer each item total and unit, apply the correct inclusive or exclusive rate and total amounts. The face sheet summarises civil cost and applicable provisions, such as contingencies, supervision or agency charges and GST. Percentages are not universally fixed: check authority, approved basis, what the rate already includes and applicable tax law. Do not apply GST twice or claim that administrative approval is a tax rate.
body.gu:
Detailed estimate નિર્ધારિત project માટે માપેલા items, quantities, specifications, unit rates અને amounts ની યાદી છે. સંકલિત plans, elevations, sections, structural તથા service details, site survey, soil/foundation માહિતી, specification, current authorised SOR અથવા યોગ્ય market rates, lead/lift, tax અને departmental rules લો. Drawing revision, measurement rules અને assumptions નોંધો.

Taking out quantities: કામને overlap વગરના items માં વહેંચો; dimensions નિશ્ચિત ક્રમમાં લો, લાગુ deductions કરો અને measurement sheet માં ગણતરી નોંધો. Abstracting: દરેક item total અને unit transfer કરી યોગ્ય inclusive/exclusive rate લગાવો. Face sheet પર civil cost તથા લાગુ contingencies, supervision/agency charges અને GST નો સાર હોય છે. Percentages સાર્વત્રિક નિશ્ચિત નથી: authority, મંજૂર basis, rate માં શું સામેલ છે અને tax law તપાસો. GST બે વાર ન લગાવો.

h.en: 3.2 Unit quantity and total quantity methods
h.gu: 3.2 Unit quantity અને total quantity methods

items.syllabus_item: 3.2 unit quantity method and total quantity method

body.en:
Unit quantity method: calculate the materials and labour for one unit of an item, establish its unit rate and multiply by measured quantity; this aligns with the usual item-rate abstract. Total quantity method: calculate the total materials, labour, equipment and other components for the entire defined work, then price them directly. Their boundaries vary by textbook and contract; state the basis and avoid adding components already included in a unit rate.

For 10 m³ masonry at ₹6,000/m³, the item-rate amount is ₹60,000. If a total-quantity analysis independently totals the same work’s material and labour costs, use that total rather than adding it again to ₹60,000.
body.gu:
Unit quantity method: Item ના એક unit માટે materials અને labour શોધી unit rate નક્કી કરો અને measured quantity થી ગુણો; આ item-rate abstract ની સામાન્ય રીત છે. Total quantity method: આખા નિર્ધારિત કામ માટે કુલ materials, labour, equipment અને અન્ય components શોધી સીધી કિંમત ગણો. Textbook અને contract પ્રમાણે boundaries બદલાઈ શકે; basis લખો અને unit rate માં પહેલેથી સામેલ components ફરી ન ઉમેરો.

10 m³ masonry નો rate ₹6,000/m³ હોય તો item amount ₹60,000 છે. જો total-quantity analysis એ જ કામના materials અને labour નો કુલ ખર્ચ અલગથી ગણે, તો તેને ₹60,000 સાથે ફરી ઉમેરવો નહીં.

body.en:
For a simple rectangular set of walls, measure long walls out-to-out and short walls in-to-in at each particular layer. If centre-to-centre dimensions are Lc and Bc and that layer has uniform width b, long-wall length = Lc + b and short-wall length = Bc − b. Multiply each length by its corresponding breadth, depth and number. Because foundation widths change at different levels, lengths change for each layer. Count walls and junctions carefully and use actual drawings; this shortcut is not a substitute for detailing irregular intersections.

In the illustrated room the 4.00 m × 3.00 m dimensions are clear inside, wall thickness is 0.23 m, and the resulting centre-line dimensions are 4.23 m × 3.23 m. For a 0.70 m trench: two long lengths 4.93 m and two short lengths 2.53 m. Numerical 3.1 completes the take-off and checks it against centre-line method.
body.gu:
સરળ rectangular walls માટે દરેક ચોક્કસ layer પર long walls out-to-out અને short walls in-to-in માપો. Centre-to-centre dimensions Lc અને Bc તથા તે layer ની uniform width b હોય તો long-wall length = Lc + b અને short-wall length = Bc − b. દરેક length ને સંબંધિત breadth, depth અને સંખ્યાથી ગુણો. Foundation widths જુદા levels પર બદલાય ત્યારે lengths ફરી ગણો. Walls અને junctions ધ્યાનથી ગણો અને actual drawing વાપરો; irregular intersections માટે આ shortcut પૂરતું નથી.

આપેલ room માં 4.00 m × 3.00 m clear inside dimensions અને 0.23 m wall thickness છે; તેથી centre-line dimensions 4.23 m × 3.23 m છે. 0.70 m trench માટે બે long lengths 4.93 m અને બે short lengths 2.53 m મળે છે. Numerical 3.1 માં take-off અને centre-line method થી ચકાસણી છે.

body.en:
For walls with the same cross-section and correctly treated corners, the centre-line method uses total effective centre-line length × breadth × depth for the relevant layer. For a simple closed rectangular ring, centre-line length is twice the sum of centre-line dimensions. Recalculate for differing wall thicknesses, offsets or stepped foundations. At T-junctions, crossings and changes of width, a naive sum of lines may count intersection areas twice; apply the appropriate junction correction from actual geometry, separately for each layer. Check against long-wall/short-wall quantities for a simple symmetrical example.

Centre-line length is not the clear inside perimeter or the outside perimeter. The foundation width, not wall thickness, is used in the earthwork layer. No generic correction applies to every junction geometry; sketch and account for each intersection once.
body.gu:
સમાન cross-section અને યોગ્ય corners ધરાવતી walls માટે centre-line method માં દરેક layer માટે total effective centre-line length × breadth × depth લેવાય છે. સરળ બંધ rectangle માં centre-line length = બંને centre-line dimensions ના સરવાળાનો બમણો. જુદી thickness, offsets કે stepped foundations માટે ફરી ગણો. T-junctions, crossings અને width changes પર lines સીધી ઉમેરવાથી intersection બે વાર ગણાઈ શકે; actual geometry પરથી દરેક layer માટે યોગ્ય junction correction કરો. સરળ symmetric ઉદાહરણને long-wall/short-wall method થી ચકાસો.

Centre-line length, clear inside perimeter કે outside perimeter નથી. Earthwork layer માટે wall thickness નહીં, foundation/trench width વાપરો. દરેક junction માટે એક જ generic correction લાગુ નથી; sketch બનાવી દરેક intersection એક જ વાર ગણો.

items.syllabus_item: 3.4 bar bending schedule footing column beam lintel chajja slab

body.en:
A BBS lists member and bar mark, diameter, shape, spacing or count, cutting length, number, total length and steel mass. Read structural details for clear cover, bar position, hooks, bends, anchorage, laps and development length; use the applicable bend-deduction and code conventions, not a universal hook allowance. A common theoretical mass approximation for round steel bars is d²/162 kg/m for diameter d in mm; it is an estimate and actual tolerances and contract basis matter.

Footings/slabs: calculate bar counts in each direction from the effective distribution distance and specified maximum spacing, then check edge bars and actual layout. Columns: list longitudinal bars and ties with anchorage and lap zones. Beams/lintels: list main, top, bent-up if specified, extra and stirrup bars; distinguish each bar mark and support anchorage. Chajjas: cantilever main steel placement and anchorage must follow the structural drawing. Never infer safe reinforcement or lap length from a quantity example.
body.gu:
BBS માં member અને bar mark, diameter, shape, spacing અથવા count, cutting length, number, total length અને steel mass લખાય છે. Clear cover, bar position, hooks, bends, anchorage, laps અને development length માટે structural details વાંચો; લાગુ bend-deduction તથા code convention વાપરો, એક universal hook allowance નહીં. Round steel માટે સામાન્ય theoretical mass અંદાજ d²/162 kg/m છે, જ્યાં d mm માં છે; actual tolerances અને contract basis પણ મહત્વના છે.

Footings/slabs: દરેક direction માં effective distribution distance અને maximum spacing પરથી bar count શોધી edge bars અને actual layout તપાસો. Columns: Longitudinal bars અને ties સાથે anchorage તથા lap zones નોંધો. Beams/lintels: Main, top, specified હોય તો bent-up, extra અને stirrup bars ને જુદા bar marks અને support anchorage સાથે નોંધો. Chajjas: Cantilever main steel અને anchorage structural drawing પ્રમાણે હોવું જરૂરી છે. Quantity example પરથી સલામત reinforcement અથવા lap length ન નક્કી કરો.

h.en: 3.6 Charges and provisions in the estimate

items.syllabus_item: 3.5 contingencies, work charged establishment, percentage charges, services

body.en:
Contingencies allow for unforeseen incidental expenditure within the approved estimate rules; they are not unlimited permission for a changed scope. Work-charged establishment covers eligible project-specific staff costs where applicable. Water supply/sanitary, electrification, supervision, agency, testing and other percentage provisions may be included as separate amounts or already in item rates. Determine the exact base and rate from the sanctioning department and project. Escalation, taxes and land costs must be identified separately if required.

Face-sheet arithmetic must show each charge’s percentage, base and amount. Avoid compounding unless the governing rule says so. GST treatment depends on the applicable law and contractual rate basis: describe the calculation assumptions rather than asserting a universal project rate.
body.gu:
Contingencies મંજૂર estimate rules હેઠળ અણધાર્યા incidental ખર્ચ માટે provision છે; scope બદલી દેવાની અમર્યાદિત મંજૂરી નથી. Work-charged establishment જ્યાં લાગુ હોય ત્યાં project-specific eligible staff costs માટે છે. Water supply/sanitary, electrification, supervision, agency, testing અને અન્ય percentage provisions અલગ હોય અથવા item rates માં સામેલ હોઈ શકે છે. ચોક્કસ base અને rate sanctioning department તથા project મુજબ નક્કી કરો. Escalation, taxes અને land costs જરૂરી હોય તો અલગ બતાવો.

Face sheet પર દરેક charge ની percentage, base અને amount દર્શાવો. નિયમ કહે ત્યારે જ compounding કરો. GST લાગુ law અને contractual rate basis પર નિર્ભર છે; એક universal rate માનવાને બદલે calculation assumptions લખો.

h.en: 3.7 BOQ, prime cost and provisional items
h.gu: 3.7 BOQ, prime cost અને provisional items

items.syllabus_item: 3.6 prime cost, provisional sum, provisional quantities, BOQ and spot items

body.en:
A bill of quantities (BOQ) lists described items, units and estimated quantities for pricing and tender comparison; actual payment follows contract measurement and adjustment provisions. A prime cost (PC) sum is an allowance for a specified supply or item not yet selected, with treatment of installation, margin and adjustment defined in the contract. A provisional sum is an allowance for work whose scope or cost cannot yet be defined adequately; expenditure requires the contractual instruction and later adjustment.

Provisional quantities are quantities marked for later confirmation, not certain final measured work. Spot/site items are project-specific or unforeseen items priced under the relevant SOR/non-SOR and contract procedure. Name the item, unit, quantity basis, rate derivation and approval; do not conflate PC sums with provisional quantities or assume every allowance is a lump-sum entitlement.
body.gu:
Bill of quantities (BOQ) માં pricing અને tenders ની સરખામણી માટે item description, unit અને estimated quantity હોય છે; actual payment contract measurement તથા adjustment provisions મુજબ છે. Prime cost (PC) sum હજી પસંદ ન થયેલા નિર્ધારિત supply/item માટે allowance છે; installation, margin અને adjustment ની રીત contract નક્કી કરે છે. Provisional sum એ કામનો allowance છે જેનો scope અથવા cost હજુ પૂરતો નિર્ધારિત ન હોય; ખર્ચ માટે contractual instruction અને પછી adjustment જરૂરી છે.

Provisional quantities પછી ખાતરી માટે દર્શાવેલી quantities છે, ચોક્કસ final measured work નથી. Spot/site items project-specific અથવા unforeseen items છે જે સંબંધિત SOR/non-SOR અને contract procedure મુજબ price થાય છે. Item, unit, quantity basis, rate derivation અને approval લખો; PC sum અને provisional quantity ને એક ન માનો કે દરેક allowance ને આપોઆપ lump-sum entitlement ન માનો.

body.en:
Given: A rectangular room has clear inside dimensions 4.00 m × 3.00 m and wall thickness 0.23 m. The concentric strip trench is 0.70 m wide and 0.45 m deep. Find excavation by long-wall/short-wall and centre-line methods. Assume uniform square-corner geometry and no internal wall.

Step 1. Calculate centre-to-centre dimensions.

Lc = 4.00 + 0.23Lc = 4.23 mBc = 3.00 + 0.23Bc = 3.23 m

Step 2. Find long-wall out-to-out and short-wall in-to-in lengths at trench width.

Long length = 4.23 + 0.70Long length = 4.93 mShort length = 3.23 − 0.70Short length = 2.53 m

Step 3. Take out quantities for two walls of each type.

Vlong = 2 × 4.93 × 0.70 × 0.45Vlong = 3.1059 m³Vshort = 2 × 2.53 × 0.70 × 0.45Vshort = 1.5939 m³Vtotal = 3.1059 + 1.5939Vtotal = 4.6998 m³

Step 4. Check with the centre-line method.

Centre-line length = 2 × (4.23 + 3.23)Centre-line length = 14.92 mV = 14.92 × 0.70 × 0.45V = 4.6998 m³

Final answer:

Excavation = 4.70 m³ after final rounding.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Rectangular room ના clear inside dimensions 4.00 m × 3.00 m અને wall thickness 0.23 m છે. Concentric strip trench 0.70 m પહોળી અને 0.45 m ઊંડી છે. Long-wall/short-wall તથા centre-line methods થી excavation શોધો. Uniform square corners અને અંદરની wall નથી એમ માનો.

Step 1. Centre-to-centre dimensions ગણો.

Lc = 4.00 + 0.23Lc = 4.23 mBc = 3.00 + 0.23Bc = 3.23 m

Step 2. Trench width પર long-wall out-to-out તથા short-wall in-to-in lengths શોધો.

Long length = 4.23 + 0.70Long length = 4.93 mShort length = 3.23 − 0.70Short length = 2.53 m

Step 3. દરેક પ્રકારની બે walls ની quantities ગણો.

Vlong = 2 × 4.93 × 0.70 × 0.45Vlong = 3.1059 m³Vshort = 2 × 2.53 × 0.70 × 0.45Vshort = 1.5939 m³Vtotal = 3.1059 + 1.5939Vtotal = 4.6998 m³

Step 4. Centre-line method થી ચકાસો.

Centre-line length = 2 × (4.23 + 3.23)Centre-line length = 14.92 mV = 14.92 × 0.70 × 0.45V = 4.6998 m³

અંતિમ જવાબ:

અંતે rounding પછી excavation = 4.70 m³.

title.en: Numerical 3.2 — Net brickwork for the same room
title.gu: Numerical 3.2 — તે જ room માટે net brickwork

body.en:
Given: Use the preceding room with 3.00 m wall height. Assume full-height masonry around the perimeter; one 0.90 m × 2.10 m door, one 1.20 m × 1.20 m window and two non-overlapping full-thickness lintels of lengths 1.20 m and 1.50 m, each 0.15 m deep. Assume these deductions apply. Find brickwork.

Step 1. Calculate gross masonry.

Gross = 14.92 × 0.23 × 3.00Gross = 10.2948 m³

Step 2. Deduct door and window volumes.

Door = 0.90 × 2.10 × 0.23Door = 0.4347 m³Window = 1.20 × 1.20 × 0.23Window = 0.3312 m³

Step 3. Calculate lintel volume and net masonry.

Lintels = (1.20 + 1.50) × 0.23 × 0.15Lintels = 0.09315 m³Net = 10.2948 − 0.4347 − 0.3312 − 0.09315Net = 9.43575 m³

Final answer:

Net brickwork ≈ 9.44 m³; lintels measured separately.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: પહેલાના room માટે wall height 3.00 m છે. સંપૂર્ણ ઊંચાઈએ perimeter masonry, એક 0.90 m × 2.10 m door, એક 1.20 m × 1.20 m window અને overlap વગર સંપૂર્ણ thickness ના 1.20 m તથા 1.50 m લાંબા, 0.15 m ઊંડા બે lintels માનો. આ deductions લાગુ છે એમ માની brickwork શોધો.

Step 1. Gross masonry ગણો.

Gross = 14.92 × 0.23 × 3.00Gross = 10.2948 m³

Step 2. Door અને window volumes બાદ કરો.

Door = 0.90 × 2.10 × 0.23Door = 0.4347 m³Window = 1.20 × 1.20 × 0.23Window = 0.3312 m³

Step 3. Lintel volume અને net masonry શોધો.

Lintels = (1.20 + 1.50) × 0.23 × 0.15Lintels = 0.09315 m³Net = 10.2948 − 0.4347 − 0.3312 − 0.09315Net = 9.43575 m³

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Net brickwork ≈ 9.44 m³; lintels અલગ માપવા.

body.en:
Given: A rectangular slab strip is 4.0 m long and 3.0 m wide. Straight 12 mm bars run in the 4.0 m direction and are distributed across the 3.0 m width, with 50 mm cover at both ends and both edges, and maximum 200 mm centre spacing. Assume no bends, hooks, laps or extra bars. Calculate count, cutting length and theoretical mass.

Step 1. Find distribution length and number of spaces.

Distribution length = 3.0 − 2 × 0.05Distribution length = 2.90 mNumber of spaces = ceiling(2.90 / 0.20)Number of spaces = 15Number of bars = 15 + 1Number of bars = 16

Step 2. Find cutting and total length.

Cutting length = 4.0 − 2 × 0.05Cutting length = 3.90 mTotal length = 16 × 3.90Total length = 62.40 m

Step 3. Calculate theoretical mass.

Unit mass ≈ d² / 162Unit mass ≈ 12² / 162Unit mass ≈ 0.8889 kg/mTotal mass ≈ 62.40 × 0.8889

Final answer:

16 bars, 3.90 m each, approximately 55.47 kg. Structural details govern actual BBS.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Rectangular slab strip 4.0 m લાંબી અને 3.0 m પહોળી છે. સીધા 12 mm bars 4.0 m દિશામાં છે અને 3.0 m width પર વહેંચાયેલા છે; બંને ends તથા edges પર 50 mm cover અને વધુમાં વધુ 200 mm centre spacing છે. Bends, hooks, laps કે extra bars નથી એમ માની count, cutting length અને theoretical mass ગણો.

Step 1. Distribution length અને spaces ની સંખ્યા શોધો.

Distribution length = 3.0 − 2 × 0.05Distribution length = 2.90 mNumber of spaces = ceiling(2.90 / 0.20)Number of spaces = 15Number of bars = 15 + 1Number of bars = 16

Step 2. Cutting અને total length શોધો.

Cutting length = 4.0 − 2 × 0.05Cutting length = 3.90 mTotal length = 16 × 3.90Total length = 62.40 m

Step 3. Theoretical mass ગણો.

Unit mass ≈ d² / 162Unit mass ≈ 12² / 162Unit mass ≈ 0.8889 kg/mTotal mass ≈ 62.40 × 0.8889

અંતિમ જવાબ:

16 bars, દરેક 3.90 m, આશરે 55.47 kg. વાસ્તવિક BBS માટે structural details અનુસરો.

body.en:
Given: An estimate has excavation 4.70 m³ at ₹300/m³ and masonry 9.44 m³ at ₹6,000/m³. Add a hypothetical contingency of 3% on item subtotal only. Rates and percentage are teaching assumptions, not current SOR or tax.

Step 1. Compute item amounts.

Excavation amount = 4.70 × 300Excavation amount = ₹1410Masonry amount = 9.44 × 6000Masonry amount = ₹56640

Step 2. Find item subtotal.

Subtotal = 1410 + 56640Subtotal = ₹58050

Step 3. Apply the stated contingency once.

Contingency = 58050 × 0.03Contingency = ₹1741.50Total = 58050 + 1741.50

Final answer:

Illustrative total = ₹59,791.50, excluding other unlisted charges.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Estimate માં excavation 4.70 m³ નો rate ₹300/m³ અને masonry 9.44 m³ નો rate ₹6,000/m³ છે. ફક્ત item subtotal પર શૈક્ષણિક 3% contingency ઉમેરો. આ rates તથા percentage current SOR કે tax નથી.

Step 1. Item amounts ગણો.

Excavation amount = 4.70 × 300Excavation amount = ₹1410Masonry amount = 9.44 × 6000Masonry amount = ₹56640

Step 2. Item subtotal શોધો.

Subtotal = 1410 + 56640Subtotal = ₹58050

Step 3. આપેલી contingency એક વાર લગાવો.

Contingency = 58050 × 0.03Contingency = ₹1741.50Total = 58050 + 1741.50

અંતિમ જવાબ:

ઉદાહરણનું total = ₹59,791.50; અન્ય ન દર્શાવેલા charges બાકાત.

title.en: Numerical 3.5 — Footing reinforcement in two directions

body.en:
Given: A 2.00 m × 1.50 m footing has 50 mm cover to the bar ends. Straight 10 mm bars run both ways with maximum spacing 200 mm. For this teaching take-off assume the specified distribution distances are 1.40 m and 1.90 m, with bars at both ends; ignore bends, laps and extras. Find counts and theoretical steel mass.

Step 1. Calculate numbers and lengths of bars in each direction.

Long-bar count = ceiling(1.40 / 0.20) + 1Long-bar count = 8Long-bar cut length = 2.00 − 2 × 0.05Long-bar cut length = 1.90 mShort-bar count = ceiling(1.90 / 0.20) + 1Short-bar count = 11Short-bar cut length = 1.50 − 2 × 0.05Short-bar cut length = 1.40 m

Step 2. Find total length and theoretical mass.

Total length = 8 × 1.90 + 11 × 1.40Total length = 30.60 mUnit mass = 10² / 162Unit mass ≈ 0.6173 kg/mTotal mass = 30.60 × 0.6173

Final answer:

8 bars of 1.90 m and 11 bars of 1.40 m; steel ≈ 18.89 kg. Structural details govern actual BBS.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 2.00 m × 1.50 m footing માં bar ends માટે 50 mm cover છે. સીધા 10 mm bars બંને દિશામાં વધુમાં વધુ 200 mm spacing પર છે. આ teaching take-off માટે distribution distances 1.40 m અને 1.90 m તથા બંને ends પર bars માનો; bends, laps અને extras અવગણો. Counts અને theoretical steel mass શોધો.

Step 1. દરેક દિશામાં bars ની સંખ્યા અને length ગણો.

Long-bar count = ceiling(1.40 / 0.20) + 1Long-bar count = 8Long-bar cut length = 2.00 − 2 × 0.05Long-bar cut length = 1.90 mShort-bar count = ceiling(1.90 / 0.20) + 1Short-bar count = 11Short-bar cut length = 1.50 − 2 × 0.05Short-bar cut length = 1.40 m

Step 2. Total length અને theoretical mass શોધો.

Total length = 8 × 1.90 + 11 × 1.40Total length = 30.60 mUnit mass = 10² / 162Unit mass ≈ 0.6173 kg/mTotal mass = 30.60 × 0.6173

અંતિમ જવાબ:

1.90 m ના 8 bars અને 1.40 m ના 11 bars; steel આશરે 18.89 kg. વાસ્તવિક BBS structural details મુજબ બનાવો.

title.gu: Numerical 3.6 — Beam stirrup schedule ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: For an illustrative 300 mm × 450 mm beam, outside cover to 8 mm stirrups is 40 mm. Stirrups extend over 3.60 m at maximum 150 mm spacing, including one at each end. Assume each has two 80 mm hook additions and no bend deduction for this teaching model; actual bend details are design-specific. Find count and theoretical mass.

Step 1. Find stirrup centre-line dimensions.

Centre-line width = 300 − 2 × 40 − 8Centre-line width = 212 mmCentre-line depth = 450 − 2 × 40 − 8Centre-line depth = 362 mm

Step 2. Find the assumed cutting length and number.

Cutting length = 2 × (212 + 362) + 2 × 80Cutting length = 1308 mmCutting length = 1.308 mNumber of spaces = ceiling(3.60 / 0.15)Number of spaces = 24Number of stirrups = 24 + 1Number of stirrups = 25

Step 3. Calculate total length and approximate mass.

Total length = 25 × 1.308Total length = 32.70 mUnit mass = 8² / 162Unit mass ≈ 0.3951 kg/mMass = 32.70 × 0.3951

Final answer:

25 stirrups; theoretical mass ≈ 12.92 kg. Use actual design bend and anchorage rules for construction.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: આદર્શ 300 mm × 450 mm beam માં 8 mm stirrups સુધી outside cover 40 mm છે. Stirrups 3.60 m length માં વધુમાં વધુ 150 mm spacing પર છે, બંને ends પર એક એક છે. આ teaching model માટે બે 80 mm hook additions અને bend deduction શૂન્ય માનો; વાસ્તવિક bend details design-specific છે. Count અને theoretical mass ગણો.

Step 1. Stirrup ની centre-line dimensions શોધો.

Centre-line width = 300 − 2 × 40 − 8Centre-line width = 212 mmCentre-line depth = 450 − 2 × 40 − 8Centre-line depth = 362 mm

Step 2. આપેલ assumptions મુજબ cutting length અને સંખ્યા શોધો.

Cutting length = 2 × (212 + 362) + 2 × 80Cutting length = 1308 mmCutting length = 1.308 mNumber of spaces = ceiling(3.60 / 0.15)Number of spaces = 24Number of stirrups = 24 + 1Number of stirrups = 25

Step 3. Total length અને અંદાજિત mass ગણો.

Total length = 25 × 1.308Total length = 32.70 mUnit mass = 8² / 162Unit mass ≈ 0.3951 kg/mMass = 32.70 × 0.3951

અંતિમ જવાબ:

25 stirrups; theoretical mass ≈ 12.92 kg. Construction માટે વાસ્તવિક design ના bend અને anchorage rules વાપરો.
